prompt:
Bold vintage screen-print T-shirt design, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

A heavy distressed banner ribbon across the middle carries the main text, which reads exactly "{name}".
Above the banner, in a rough hand-drawn arch, the words LETZTE NACHT IN FREIHEIT.
Under the banner a small stencil line reads exactly "{rolle}".
[[A curved line below reads exactly "{stadt}".]]
[[A small ticket-stamp box in the lower area reads exactly "{datum}".]]
[[A handwritten line at the very bottom reads exactly "{spruch}".]]

Behind the lettering, as a lively background scene, a Mallorca / Ballermann party pontoon (a floating wooden party platform on the water) crowded with a cheering group of women raising drinks, sunshine and confetti - drawn as a rough, fun illustration that stays behind the text and never covers it. The words Mallorca and Ballermann describe the scene only - they must NOT appear anywhere as lettering, on a sign, a banner or a board.

Style: two-color retro screen print, black line work with one strong warm accent color, halftone dot shading, worn and cracked edges, 1970s beer-label energy.
